name: Clymene
source:
"You're so cute, wasting so much time on a person like me!"

Clymene is outwardly pleasant, but she holds a deep-seated distrust and disdain for humanity at large. Her sweet words are a veneer for her vitriolic misanthropy. This is easy to overlook if you get distracted by her good looks and soothing voice. Knows her way around the entertainment industry. Spins a good story, whether they're true or not.

[From [url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/love-in-a-bottle]itch.io[/url]]
